snippet.title: Volatiles - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
🔫Wishlist #Volatiles now: https://re.11bits.com/57e

We're so happy to announce Volatiles, a new title joining our 11 bit portfolio, created by Team Instant Defeat 🧡

In Volatiles, the fight for survival takes place in your mind, as each run sends you deeper into an analog sci-fi nightmare.

Lay out your survival in a top-down action roguelike where every tile expands your battlefield and survive the invasion within.
